title: Sphere Circles
desc: Tangential circles orbiting a sphere — full controls on desktop, a touch-friendly phone app you can install.

changelog.notes: Save Flow snapshots; with 2+ snaps Auto flow morphs between them instead of sparse random wander.
In fullscreen, a floating stick pops up every minute or two so you can try hold-drag.
Full 360° Orbit with a soft pitch rock; long-press Orbit for multi-axis dance speeds.
Toggle circle strokes off in Look, leaving dots when Dots is on.
Put Circles and Phase first in the Motion dock sheet.
